target.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Copilot BYOK users could have the local provider proxy buffer an unbounded request body before forwarding when the SDK sent an unexpectedly large POST.

## Why This Change Was Made

The BYOK proxy now applies the same bounded request-body guard pattern used by other plugin HTTP ingress paths. Oversized requests are rejected locally with 413 before reaching the guarded upstream fetch.

## User Impact

Users keep the same BYOK provider behavior for normal SDK requests, while malformed or runaway local requests can no longer grow proxy memory without a cap.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/copilot/src/byok-proxy.test.ts`: 4 tests passed
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/copilot/src/byok-proxy.ts extensions/copilot/src/byok-proxy.test.ts`: passed
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/copilot/src/byok-proxy.ts extensions/copilot/src/byok-proxy.test.ts`: passed
